controls.fixture_boundary: Capability/admission/response-budget controls use fixtures; renderer exception type is import-only, with zero renderer calls. They do not establish live authorization or user acceptance.

genuine_input_files.scope: Read-only native structure and opaque project sanity; no macro execution or safety semantics.

controls.preserved: Source-bound data reading, selected-title merge, preserving chart/workbook edit and fit-refusal boundary; five unchanged native leaves retain identical bytes.
controls.publication_preparation: Hashes, JSON inventory, patch paths and private-data scan only; no product tests were repeated.
controls.reconstruction: Independent patch --fuzz=0 against all ten accepted Source118 beforeimages; every reconstructed afterimage matches the accepted candidate.
significant_negatives: Wrong native type/extension; missing, duplicate, orphan, wrong-owner, namespace/case-spoofed or mismatched VBA project; nonmacro packages containing VBA; invalid CFB header.
External active relationships; unsafe archive paths, links, expansion, CRC, DTD and malformed XML.
Cross-user/path/link/permission/cancellation fixture refusals, including cancellation after extraction before response.
Macro text writes and unsupported create/edit/merge/convert routes refuse before effects.

installed_baseline: Source117 unchanged; this source-only delta is not installed and has no bound native generation or runtime.
patch_scope: Five changed native leaves in the ten-leaf accepted Source118 graph; bounded read-only PPTM/POTM/PPSM support through ordinary read_file routing.

predecessor.relation: Apply this exact patch to the Source118 native afterimages, not to installed Source117. NATIVE-FILES.json lists all ten exact before/after hashes.

reader.behavior: Bounded native slide text, tables, cached chart data and separate speaker notes; ordinary scoped reading and pagination retained.
reader.identity: Exact per-variant native main content type, one exact Microsoft VBA relationship owned by the presentation root, one matching declared ZIP member and plausible CFB header/sector alignment.
reader.macro_metadata: Opaque VBA project presence, byte count and SHA-256; no source inspection, p-code disassembly, execution, signature verification or macro safety claim.
reader.style_metadata: Bounded theme, slide-master and slide-layout XML-root counts only; no style inheritance, layout or rendering evaluation.
reader.write_boundary: Macro create/edit/merge/convert/execution remains unsupported; refusal precedes file creation.

remaining_gaps: Macro source/p-code semantics, signatures and safety remain unproven; macros are never executed by this reader.
Legacy binary POT/PPS and generic source-bound table/conclusion/basis editing remain outside this delta.
source119_full_carrier: Complete carrier independently reviewed after initial publication; see SOURCE119-CARRIER.json. Source-only, not installed.
